rule_checks.odds_note: Each rule either passes or fails. A building that passes every rule is allowed outright.

code_sections.title: Site Development Standards
code_sections.summary: Moderate-Density (M): minimum lot 2,400 sf; front, rear and street side 30 ft (RM 25); interior 5 ft (RM 10); max 40 ft/3 stories (RM 55 ft/4 stories).

code_sections.title: Use Table
code_sections.summary: The Use Table shows, for each district, whether a use is allowed by right (P), by Administrator Exception (A), Special Exception (S), Conditional Use (C), or not at all (blank).
The procedures under which the Zoning Board of Adjustment considers variance requests; subsection 922.09.E lists considerations the Board weighs.

code_sections.title: Development Subdistricts
code_sections.summary: Sets residential lot size, setbacks and height by density level (VL, L, M, H, VH); contextual setbacks and heights may be used, and Chapter 915 environmental rules add limits.

code_sections.title: UM-O, Undermined Area Overlay District
code_sections.summary: Over mapped undermined land, the underlying zoning still applies, but builders must investigate mine conditions and may face limits or special construction techniques to reduce subsidence risk.

code_sections.title: Elevation and Floodproofing Requirements
code_sections.summary: In AE and A flood zones, new or substantially improved buildings must raise the lowest floor, including basement, to the regulatory flood elevation; non-residential buildings may be floodproofed instead.

code_sections.title: FP-O, Floodplain overlay district
code_sections.summary: In the floodway, no fill, new building or other encroachment is allowed unless engineering analysis shows no rise in base flood levels, and a DEP permit is required.

code_sections.title: Off-Street Parking Schedules
code_sections.summary: Sets minimum and maximum off-street parking by use: 1 space per unit for most homes (0 for attached single-unit), up to 4 per unit for single-unit and 2 otherwise.

code_sections.title: Building Height and Setback Standards
code_sections.summary: Near R1D, R1A, R2, R3 or H lots, covered development needs larger setbacks (often 15 ft) and max 40 ft/3 stories within 50 ft, 50 ft/4 stories at 51-100 ft.

code_sections.title: Environmental Standards
code_sections.summary: Sets grading, cut-and-fill, retaining wall, slope replanting, tree survey and tree replacement rules; the grading rules apply to all slopes.
